plugins.name: Region picker
plugins.description: Adds a region button to the search bar, so you can switch the search region without opening settings.

plugins.name: Music card
plugins.description: Shows a song, album or artist card when the results link to it on a music service.

plugins.name: Weather card
plugins.description: Shows a weather card when the results link to a city forecast on a weather site.
